scenes.hook: Your website works on your computer. Give it a public address with GitHub Pages.
scenes.idea: For the free public repository option, upload your static files, including index dot H T M L.
scenes.code: Open the repository settings, then Pages. Choose deploy from a branch.
scenes.result: Select your source branch and folder, then save. Keep the entry file at that source root.
scenes.tip: Wait for the deployment to finish. Pages shows the address you can visit and share.
scenes.caution: Keep passwords and private files out. Pages serves static files, not a custom application server.
scenes.try: Open the published address on your phone. Check the layout, links, and images.
scenes.close: Subscribe to Tech at sixty and keep building.
